CreateUserInvitationCode.description_en: Creates dedicated terminal management invitation codes for one or more users under the current Alibaba Cloud account, generates an eight-digit code for each user, and uniformly specifies the terminal group and validity period
CreateUserInvitationCode.description_zh: 为当前阿里云账号下的一个或多个用户创建专属终端纳管邀请码，每个用户生成一个八位数字码，并统一指定终端分组和有效期

DeleteClients.description_en: Removes endpoint devices from management based on their UUIDs
DeleteClients.description_zh: 根据UUID移除终端设备纳管

DescribeClients.description_en: Queries the information of all managed clients
DescribeClients.description_zh: 查询所有已纳管客户端信息

GetCustomResourceStats.description_zh: 获取定制资源统计信息

GetOrCreateInvitationCode.description_en: Retrieves the invitation code for desktop client management. In query mode, if only TerminalGroupId is specified, the current invitation code and its expiration status are returned. In creation mode, if TerminalGroupId and an expiration duration (ExpireDays or ExpireMinutes) are specified, a new code is generated and overwrites the existing invitation code
GetOrCreateInvitationCode.description_zh:
获取桌面端纳管邀请码。
查询模式：仅传 terminalGroupId，只读返回当前邀请码及过期状态。
创建模式：必须传terminalGroupId+过期时长——传 expireDays或expireMinutes，会生成新码并覆盖原邀请码

ListVersionDistribution.description_en: Queries the distribution of endpoint versions
ListVersionDistribution.description_zh: 查询终端版本分布情况
